"Create a 2D action pixel-art platformer game set on dark city rooftops at night. The main playable character is a fast and agile black cat. The enemies are slow-moving mechanical turtles patrolling the platforms. Jumping on top of a turtle defeats it, but colliding with a turtle from the sides reduces player health. The goal is to jump across rooftop platforms, avoid obstacles, collect fish items, and reach the end of the level

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
